The primary responsibility will be teaching undergraduate courses in accounting full-time on main campus in seated classes. Duties and Responsibilities Trine University is a teaching-focused institution. A standard teaching load for faculty is 12 credit hours per semester. Faculty are expected to spend 80% of their time on teaching, 10% on scholarship, and 10% on university service. Trine does not offer tenure. High-quality teaching is Trine University’s priority; however, faculty members are also expected to engage in professional development activities, develop/maintain appropriate professional contacts, and serve as academic advisors for students. Service, in the form of committee work, advising student organizations, etc. is highly valued. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of an MBA and be a CPA, but exceptionally qualified applicants with other areas of experience and expertise may be considered. Duties and Responsibilities Trine University is a teaching-focused institution. A standard teaching load for faculty is 12 credit hours per semester. Faculty are expected to spend 80% of their time on teaching, 10% on scholarship, and 10% on University Service. Trine does not offer tenure. High quality teaching is Trine University’s first priority; however, faculty members are also expected to engage in professional development activities, develop/maintain appropriate professional contacts, and serve as an academic advisor for students. Service, in the form of committee work, advising student organizations, etc. is highly valued. The ideal candidate will have a background in management and strategy, but exceptionally qualified applicants with other areas of experience and expertise may be considered. The successful candidate will be able to teach undergraduate courses such as Global Strategic Management, Designing Operations, Project Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Law & Ethics, Entrepreneurship, and others. Expected teaching load is 12 hours per term. Duties will begin August 2026. Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Demonstrated education or experience that would support the teaching of specified management and business courses; A demonstrated record of excellence and innovation in teaching; An extensive professional network and business connections; A commitment to serve as a faculty advisor, student organization advisor, and active member of the undergraduate teaching team; A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in a management role. A strong understanding of and commitment to the Trine culture and to the Angola community. Candidates will be committed to working full-time at Trine and serving students and the university in a variety of ways. Required Education An earned doctorate in management or closely related discipline is preferred; Minimum qualification for the position is a Master of Business Administration or master’s degree in higher education or business-related field with demonstration of relevant work experience. Salary Rank and salary will be based on qualifications. Outstanding Benefits: Trine University offers a comprehensive benefit package designed to provide a variety of choices to best fit your needs and the needs of your family. Some benefits offered include: Health - medical, dental, flex spending, HSA accounts Life insurance - a variety of voluntary life options are available along with an employer paid employee life policy valued at 1 ½ times annual salary Paid vacation and sick time Retirement - after one year of full-time service you are eligible for an employer contribution of 5% and up to an additional 5% employer match Review of candidates will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Candidates should send a letter of interest, a curriculum vitae, detailing all academic & professional experience, plus the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of three references within their application. Are you ready to join Trine? Trine University is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, national origin, genetic information, citizenship status, military status, or any other basis prohibited by law, unless such basis constitutes a bona fide occupational qualification. Trine will comply with its legal obligation to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs.

We seek a dynamic, student-centered educator with expertise in thermal and fluid sciences who will contribute to our mission of promoting intellectual and personal development through professionally focused and formative learning opportunities, preparing students to succeed, lead, and serve. The successful candidate will demonstrate a passion for teaching, mentoring, and engaging undergraduates in both classroom and laboratory settings, and will also pursue scholarly and professional activities that support and enhance undergraduate education. Supervise undergraduate design and research projects, including capstone design and other experiential learning opportunities. Maintain regular office hours and provide thoughtful academic and career advising. Scholarship & Professional Development Pursue scholarly activity consistent with the institution’s mission, the scholarship of teaching and learning, pedagogical innovation, or industry collaboration. Remain active through professional society participation (e.g., ASME, AIChE, ASEE) and continuing professional growth. Support accreditation (ABET) and assessment efforts. Education and/or Experience Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or closely related field with an emphasis in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, or energy systems. IU LAB is expected to open in the 16 Tech Innovation District in 2027.
